sunoData.title: Torch Vault Descent
sunoData.tags: Dark ambient dungeon game music with slow pulsing low end, restrained taiko hits, distant metallic drones, and tense asymmetric percussion for claustrophobic exploration; verse-like sections drift on hollow bells and bowed textures, pre-drop builds tighten with ticking trap motifs, and a lower, pressure-filled climax swells with rumbling toms and echoing stone impacts. Sparse breathy room tails, occasional reversed swells, dripping echoes, and subtle sidechain movement under a wide, cavernous, polished mix., ambient
